  • Method Details

    • referenceFeature

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder referenceFeature(@NonNull java.lang.String value)
      Set the reference face feature for this 1:1 verification. Required.

    • threshold

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder threshold(float value)
      Set the identity-similarity threshold. Recommended: 0.75–0.85; default: 0.80. Accepts [0,1]. The score is not an identity probability.

    • enableSilentLiveness

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder enableSilentLiveness(boolean value)
      Enable combined verification. After any optional actions, passive liveness and dynamic 1:1 verification run in the same final window instead of starting identity comparison only after liveness ends.

    • actions

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder actions(@NonNull java.util.List<FaceAction> value)
      Set ordered actions before final 1:1 verification. Repeated actions are allowed, with at most four steps. An empty list means no actions.

    • actionTimeoutMillis

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder actionTimeoutMillis(long value)
      Set the time allowance per action, at least 2000 ms.

    • faceAcquisitionTimeoutMillis

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder faceAcquisitionTimeoutMillis(long value)
      Set the maximum wait for the first eligible face, 1000..60000 ms.

    • allowMultipleFaces

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder allowMultipleFaces(boolean allowed)
      Whether other faces may appear at the same time. Default false. Enabling this does not guarantee identity continuity across frames.

    • resultEncryption

      @NonNull public FaceVerificationConfig.Builder resultEncryption(@NonNull java.lang.String sessionId, @NonNull java.lang.String publicKey)
